profile_text.body:
Meta is a public company, ticker META, founded in 2004 and headquartered in Menlo Park, CA, USA. Its developer site describes building with Meta's AI models and tools, with access to Muse Spark through Muse Code and the Meta Model API. The company describes Muse Spark as tuned for long-horizon coding workflows, with fewer unnecessary turns and cleaner output, and says it performs competitively with frontier models across several coding evals. The site says a first working request takes under five minutes by pointing an existing OpenAI SDK compatible client at the Meta Model API, and that search grounding gives a model live access to the web by adding a single tool to a request.

The product tracked for Meta is Llama (Meta), described as an open-weight model family that is often self-hosted. Meta's most recent revenue filing is a 10-K for the period ending 2025-12-31, reporting $200,966,000,000, under CIK 0001326801.

Meta is a defendant in four tracked cases: State of New Mexico ex rel. Torrez v. Meta Platforms, Inc. in the First Judicial District Court, Santa Fe County, New Mexico; Neural AI, LLC v. Meta Platforms, Inc. in the District Court, W.D. Texas; Chicken Soup for the Soul, LLC v. Meta Platforms Inc. in the District Court, N.D. California; and Kadrey v. Meta Platforms, Inc. in the U.S. District Court, N.D. California. California is recorded as its largest law exposure location, with 281 cases. MCP servers listed for Meta Ads automation include ai.adweave/meta-ads-mcp, co.pipeboard/meta-ads-mcp, and com.adbloop/meta-ads.
